disposition: Narrow optimization is reasonable after unused upstream counting is disabled and framing validation is strengthened; real fixture parity remains required. No measured speedup or browser latency cure is established.
confirmed_format_properties: Ordinary record maxsplit=8, rename/copy maxsplit=9 and unmerged maxsplit=10 match documented v2 field positions.
Rename/copy target and original paths are both retained; original is a separate raw NUL record and must not be interpreted as a header or entry even when its filename starts with # or ?.
surrogateescape and bounded space splitting preserve raw filename spaces, tabs, newlines and non-UTF8 bytes in changed_paths; later path-policy checks are not bypassed.
Unknown headers are ignored as required by the extensible v2 header contract. Unsupported entry types are rejected; ignored-file entries are not requested.
Committed HEAD remains required: (initial) is rejected; 40/64 lowercase hexadecimal OIDs accepted; (detached) maps to None.
Root resolution and injected _execute dispatch remain; environment overrides, hook/fsmonitor restrictions, optional-lock suppression and timeouts are unchanged.

required_minimal_adjustments.issue: --branch defaults to upstream ahead/behind counts; branch.ab is unused. This can introduce avoidable history traversal.
required_minimal_adjustments.recommendation: Add --no-ahead-behind to the same status command; retain branch.oid/head and unknown-header handling.
required_minimal_adjustments.severity: bounded performance risk, not measured regression

required_minimal_adjustments.issue: v1 accepts missing trailing NUL and silently ignores interior empty NUL records.
required_minimal_adjustments.recommendation: Require final NUL and iterate all records except only its final empty split element; reject interior empty records while preserving legal raw filenames.
required_minimal_adjustments.severity: structural parser validation gap; no repository input exploit demonstrated

required_minimal_adjustments.issue: v1 overwrites duplicate known branch.oid/head headers.
required_minimal_adjustments.recommendation: Reject duplicate required known headers rather than selecting the last one.
required_minimal_adjustments.severity: structural parser validation gap; no legitimate Git output requires duplicates

validation_claim_limits: v1 checks field count, nonempty extracted paths and final HEAD/branch presence; it does not validate the complete XY/submodule/mode/OID/rename-score token grammar. Do not claim all malformed metadata is rejected.
Ignored metadata is not used for application authority; avoid expanding parser complexity without a concrete needed invariant.

status no longer virtually dispatches resolve_commit(root, HEAD). A custom LocalGitService subclass implementing denial/transformation only there changes behavior; no such repository subclass was found. Root and _execute overrides remain.
Third-party GitService implementations are unaffected because status remains the same public method and return contract.
No cross-command filesystem/Git snapshot atomicity is promised; one status process reduces separate metadata observations but concurrent external mutations remain possible.

Unknown headers accepted; missing/duplicate required headers, invalid HEAD, unsupported entries, truncated record fields, empty extracted paths, missing/empty rename original, missing final NUL and interior empty records rejected.
Count exactly two subprocesses in LocalGitService.status (root plus status), without weakening public deadlines or guards; actual end-to-end performance remains a separate fresh-source gate.
